newsitem.title: USA: Triumph Group sees 20 pct earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Triumph Group sees 20 pct earnings growth.

text.p: Triumph Group Inc said Wednesday it expects earnings to grow 20 percent a year for the next three to five years.
The aviation services company said half of the growth will come from internal operations, and the other half from future acquisitions.
Triumph will continue to explore acquisitions, expand its existing operations base and refine its capital structure, said Richard Ill, Triumph chief executive.
The statement was made at the Dillon, Read and Co Airlines, Aviation Services and Logistics Conference here.
